外文有关吸入性或鼻内用糖皮质激素在临床使用过程中因药物相互作用而导致的医源性库欣综合征的相关报道做一综述。
Focus on Iatrogenic Cushing's Syndrome Caused by Drug Interactions
TANG Zhi-hui1,2, MU Yi-ming2\*1. Clinical Pharmacy Centre, General Hospital of Chinese PLA, Beijing 100853, China; 2. Department of Endocrinology, General Hospital of Chinese PLA, Beijing 100853, China[Abstract] Inhaled glucocorticoids or intranasal glucocorticoids were previously considered safe, but in recent years, more and more reports show that inhaled glucocorticoids or intranasal glucocorticoids caused iatrogenic Cushing's syndrome, especially in patients taking CYP3A4 inhibitors at the same time. Therefore, this article reviews the iatrogenic Cushing's syndrome caused by drug interactions.吸入性糖皮质激素(inhaled corticosteroid， I C S)或鼻内用糖皮质激素 (i n t r a n a s a lcorticosteroids，INCS)被广泛用于治疗哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺疾病(chronic obstructive pulmonary disease，COPD)、过敏性鼻炎(allergic rhinitis，AR)、支气管哮喘(bronchial asthma，BA)等呼吸系统疾病，其主要的不良反应(adverse drug reaction，ADR)分为局部和全身，局部ADR包括发音障碍、口咽部假丝酵母菌病(鹅口疮)、接触性的超敏反应等；全身ADR包括医源性库欣综合征(Cushing syndrome，CS)、肺部感染、骨质疏松等[1]。ICS和INCS在正常剂量范围内通常不会引起医源性库欣综合征，单独使用ICS或INCS出现医源性库欣综合征的文献报道也很少[2,3]。纳入5项随机试验(732例成人患者)的Meta分析结果发现，每日使用500μg、1000μg、1500μg和2000μg氟替卡松的患者的肾上腺功能异常发生率分别仅为6%、7%、10%和13%。而另外一项纳入64项研究的Meta
